newIssues.title: Sofa Customize leaves the sofa's right arm end, its base rail and patches of the cushions grey. The demo's hero V2 (the client's favourite) shows it
newIssues.width: 1440 (the image is the same at every width)
newIssues.repro: Living room Original › Furniture › Grey Fabric Sofa › Customize › Velvet + Emerald › Generate. Or open Kevin Ng › Living room › V2, or the client link /renders/17fe84ab2eca47.
newIssues.evidence: The sofa's highlight covers the whole sofa (c2-sofa-highlight.png). The render paints the back and cushions but leaves the right arm's end panel under the throw grey (image x≈528–565, y≈450–590 of 900×603). The base rail along the bottom stays grey, and grey patches stay at the cushions' right end and in the middle. The painted edge is a straight vertical line. Round 1's lr-cu-sofa.jpg shows the same, so it is not a regression, but nobody reported it. It is on Kevin Ng's V2, which the client link shows as 'Your favourite'.
newIssues.fix: The recolour key seems to reject the sofa's shaded side fabric. For a Customize of the whole piece, paint the piece's traced outline and leave out only the traced cuts (the throw, the cushions of other colours), not pixels keyed by lightness. Then re-render the demo V2 / V3 (scripts/viz/demo-renders.mts) and run db:baseline.

The lamp's row and its Remove / Replace / Customize actions are at y 763–795, under the Describe box, and nothing shows in view (o2-1280-marker-lamp.png). At 1280 and 1440, Fiddle Leaf Fig › Customize puts the Planter and Colour chips at y 732–852, below the fold, while the footer says 'Pick a colour or a finish … first' (o1-1280-Fiddle-Leaf-Fig-Customize.png). The Tools panel already scrolls a picked tool into view (checks), so Furniture and Surfaces should do the same.
newIssues.fix: When a piece is picked (marker or row), scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' }) on its row plus its actions. When an action opens its options, scroll so the first options group is in view (reduced motion: no smooth). Use the same helper the Tools panel uses.

newIssues.title: A piece added by one click gets almost no region, so its Customize paints a small blotch inside it

newIssues.title: Armchair Customize / Replace paints the wooden arms and the wall seen under the arm, and leaves the seat's top edge pale
newIssues.repro: Living room Original › Upholstered Armchair › Customize › Velvet + Mustard › Generate. Or Replace › Mid-Century armchair.
newIssues.evidence: The upholstery colour covers the wooden arm frames and fills the gap under the right arm, which should show the wall. A pale unpainted band stays along the seat's back edge (z-arm-must.png against z-arm-orig.png). Round 1's lr-cu-arm.jpg shows the same, but nobody reported it.
newIssues.fix: Trace the armchair's arm gap as a hole in the piece, and its wooden frame as a 'frame' part that an Upholstery finish leaves alone. Include the seat's lit top edge.

newIssues.title: Kitchen 'Charcoal Lower Cabinets' misses the drawer run behind the island and includes the plinth recess
newIssues.repro: Kitchen Original › Cabinets › Charcoal Lower Cabinets › Sage Laminate › Generate.
newIssues.evidence: The outline stops at x≈430 of the stage (g5-lower-cab.png). The drawer run under the hob, between the island top and the worktop, stays charcoal next to the sage run. The toe-kick recess is painted as a pale green slab (z-kt-cab.png).
newIssues.fix: Extend the lower-cabinet trace to the visible drawer run behind the island, and cut the plinth recess out, or make it its own shadowed surface.

newIssues.title: Kitchen floor: a strip of grey tile stays unpainted under the island's overhang
newIssues.repro: Kitchen Original › Light Grey Tile Floor › Oak Herringbone › Generate.
newIssues.evidence: A grey-blue band of the original tile runs along the island's base, between the island and the herringbone, from the waterfall to the right end (z-kt-stools.png).
newIssues.fix: Take the floor outline up to the island's base line. The shaded floor under the overhang is still floor.

newIssues.title: After a reference photo is added, the Style panel doesn't bring the reference and its settings into view
newIssues.repro: Living room › Style › Upload a reference photo › pick kitchen-moodboard.jpg.
newIssues.evidence: The Generate button turns into 'Style transfer' and a 'Reference · 1' chip appears. But the panel stays scrolled on the style cards: the new thumbnail shows as a 12 px sliver at the panel's foot, and How far / What carries over are out of view (e2-ref.png).
newIssues.fix: After a reference is added, scroll its block into view, the same way the Tools panel does for a picked tool.

newIssues.title: Tapping to add a surface where one is already marked makes a duplicate
newIssues.repro: Kitchen Original › Surfaces › + › 'Island side' › Click where it is › click the island's waterfall end.
newIssues.evidence: The new 'Island Side' has the same outline as the existing 'Quartz Island Waterfall End'. Countertops now has 3 entries, two of them the same region (g2-kt-island.png).
newIssues.fix: When the tap lands inside an existing surface's region, offer that surface ('That’s the Quartz Island Waterfall End — pick it?') instead of adding a copy.

newIssues.title: The Customize summary reads as a contradiction: 'Navy matte black pot'
newIssues.repro: Fig › Customize › Planter: Matte black pot + Colour: Navy.
newIssues.evidence: The row and the helper line read 'Customize · Navy matte black pot'. The render is a navy pot (a2-fig-picked.png).
newIssues.fix: When a colour is picked with a finish that names a colour, drop the finish's colour word ('Navy matte pot'), or show 'Matte black pot, in Navy'.

newIssues.title: Snackbars land on the photo's bottom-left corner at 1025–1440 (F014's 'off the photo' does not hold)
newIssues.repro: Open a room with versions and delete a version (or Generate, or Change photo). Watch where 'V1 deleted · Undo' / 'V4 is ready · Compare' lands.
newIssues.evidence: The snackbar (344×48, x16–360) is lifted above the canvas bar because the bar starts inside its band (bar.left 318 at 1440, 238 at 1280, 128 at 1025). Overlap with the photo: 27 px at 1440 (snack y775–823, photo bottom 802), 44 px at 1280 (y551–599 over x94–360, photo bottom 595) and 44 px at 1025. At 1920 the bar starts at 558, so the snackbar rests above the strip and clears the photo. The editor's comment and the F014 claim say it 'rests above the versions, off the photo' beside a narrow bar.
newIssues.fix: Either correct the claim and accept the corner, or, when lifting over the bar would put it on the photo, dock it at the bar's row by narrowing the host to the space left of the bar (bar.left − 32; this fails below about 1340) or over the strip's head column. The owner should pick. The rule is in the F014 · F089 · F140 effect in visualizer-editor.tsx.

newIssues.title: Keyboard: with a strip tile focused, ← → change the version on screen but focus stays behind, leaving two identical purple rings
newIssues.repro: With V5 on screen, Tab to the V2 tile and press ← twice.
newIssues.evidence: The chip goes V5 → V4 → V3 while document.activeElement stays 'Show V2 …'. V2 wears the focus ring and V3 the selected ring, both 2px primary, so you cannot tell which one is on screen.
newIssues.fix: When the keydown comes from a strip tile, move focus to the tile just shown (a roving list, as the mode tabs do), or step from the focused tile. Also give :focus-visible a look distinct from the selected ring (e.g. an outline offset in on-surface).

newIssues.title: Focus falls to <body> after deleting a version from its ⋯ menu, and after the last restore closes Deleted versions
newIssues.repro: Keyboard: open V1's ⋯, choose Delete. Or open 'n deleted', focus the only Restore and press Enter.
newIssues.evidence: After Delete, activeElement is BODY (the kebab left with its tile). After the last restore the dialog closes, the 'n deleted' trigger it would return to is gone, and activeElement is BODY at both 1440 and 390. A keyboard or screen-reader user loses their place in the strip.
newIssues.fix: After a delete, focus the neighbouring tile (the next, else the previous). After the last restore, focus the restored version's tile (or the strip's 'Versions' list).

newIssues.title: Once its parent is deleted, a tile drops its provenance while Present still says 'From V2'
newIssues.repro: V2 → V3 → V4 chain. Delete V3, then read V4's tile name or caption tooltip, and open Present on V4.
newIssues.evidence: After V3 is deleted, the tile reads 'V4, on screen · Walls' with no 'made from', while Present's head says 'From V2' and its button 'Before and after · V2'. Deleting V1 likewise strips V2's 'made from V1'. The strip looks up the parent only among live versions.
newIssues.fix: In versions-strip.tsx derive `from` with beforeKeyOf (the nearest live ancestor), as Present and Compare do: 'made from V2'. Or say 'made from V3, deleted'.

newIssues.title: Present at 1024×768 touch: both side blocks open cut mid-line ('Ceiling' clipped, a 20 px sliver of the first thumbnail row)
newIssues.repro: Open Present on the latest version of a room with 5 or more tiles on a landscape tablet.
newIssues.evidence: The side is 220 px wide. Facts are 254 px tall, and the third 'Everything in V4' row ('Ceiling') is cut through its glyphs at the bottom edge. The thumbs block (221 px) opens at scrollTop 62, so the first row shows only its bottom edge and the captions 'Original' and 'V1' float without their pictures. It reads as clipping rather than as a scroller.
newIssues.fix: Give .thumbs scroll-snap-type: y mandatory, with scroll-snap-align on .thumb (or round keepInView to a row). Add a short fade mask at the facts' bottom edge while more is below.

newIssues.title: Version captions and 'What changed' name a changed surface by the finish it replaced
newIssues.repro: Floor → Walnut Engineered, then Generate. Then Ceiling → Olive Green with Walls → Sage Green, Generate. Then customise the Grey Fabric Sofa to sage green linen.
newIssues.evidence: The strip and chip read 'V1 · Light Oak Floor' for a walnut floor, 'V2 · Walls, White Ceiling' for an olive ceiling, and 'V5 · Grey Fabric Sofa' for a sage linen sofa. Present's 'What changed' says 'White Ceiling — Olive Green', but the list under it ('Everything in V2') says 'Ceiling — Olive Green', so one surface has two names in one panel. The labels come from the reading, which carries the photo's original finish.
newIssues.fix: For captions and change lines, use the group word where the reading's label carries its old finish (Floor, Ceiling, Sofa), as 'Everything in' and the moodboard do. Or keep the label and add the new finish ('Floor → Walnut Engineered'). This is a copy call for the owner.

newIssues.title: A version's ⋯ with the Original on screen offers a disabled 'Compare · Show a version first'
newIssues.repro: Put the Original on screen, then open V5's ⋯.
newIssues.evidence: The first row is greyed with the meta 'Show a version first', although the menu belongs to a version and comparing it with the Original is the obvious ask. The canvas bar's Compare is disabled too.
newIssues.fix: In that case offer 'Compare with the Original' (V5 against the photo) or 'Before and after' (V5 against its parent) instead of a dead row.

newIssues.title: Pin-mode banner covers the top third of the photo on a phone held sideways
newIssues.repro: On a phone in landscape, open a room and press Pin a note.
newIssues.evidence: The banner is 356×44 at y72 (x94–450), wider than the whole 222 px photo (x161–383, y64–212), and hides its top 44 px, the ceiling, where a note may be pinned. Presses pass through, but the spot is hidden. The chip is hidden (low layout), so the banner could go elsewhere.
newIssues.fix: In the short layouts, put the banner in the free grey beside the photo (161 px left of it here), or at the stage's bottom above the bar. Or shorten it there to 'Tap where your note goes · Cancel'.

checks.what: D3 Customize by part (the fig's Planter, the art's Frame, the TV's frame and stand, the lamps' shade and base; no part row on a piece without a traced part; the 'Colour · the pot' wording)
checks.evidence: 1440. Each finish paints only its part: the fig pot (leaves and soil kept), the living-room and bedroom frames (canvases kept), the TV bezel and stand (screen kept), the floor lamp's shade (Linen + Mustard) and its pole (Brass / Matte black), and the bedroom lamp's shade (Sage) and base (Brass). The headings read 'COLOUR · THE POT', 'COLOUR · THE FRAME' and 'COLOUR · THE FRAME AND STAND'; lamps say 'COLOUR'. A hand-added 'Basil Plant in a Pot' offers no Planter row, only Colour, as specified. Its render is a separate new issue. Shots: z-fig-pot.png, z-art.png, z-tv.png, z-lamp.png, z-bd.png.

checks.what: Remove on the living room, piece by piece, each render looked at full size
checks.evidence: Clean: TV console (it takes the TV's feet, and the TV hangs on the wall), floor lamp (its own piece), fig (its wall shadow goes), TV, art. Not clean: sofa (armchair rebuilt with a white arm block, a seat blob and wedges between its legs; the rug continues but with a seam, a step and a tiled look; the table's front smeared, the table floating with no left legs), coffee table (the console's rail torn with a white gap line; a rug slab where the leg was), rug (a remnant by the throw's fringe), armchair (the chair's shadow ghost on the wall; a pale stub on the lamp pole). See F181. Shots: EV-sofa-remove.png, EV-coffee-rug-armchair-remove.png.

checks.what: The Tools panel scrolls a picked tool's options into view
checks.evidence: At 1280×800, Tools › Furnish the room scrolls the panel so the picked card with its room select, density chips and 'Will place' box sits in view. At 1440 everything fits (k2-1280-Furnish-the-room.png). Furniture and Style do not do the same (new issues).

checks.what: The Describe box's example fits whole at every rail width
checks.evidence: Measured in the box's own font. 1440: the full sentence on 2 of 2 lines. 1280×800, 1366×768, 1025×768 and 1024t: 'e.g. walnut floor, sage green walls' on 1 line. 768t, 390t and 375×667t: 'Describe a change, e.g. sage walls'. 320t and 844×390t: 'Describe a change…'. Nothing is cut.

checks.what: The style cards line up picture, name, description and materials across a row
checks.evidence: 25 cards in 13 rows at 1440, 1280, 1025, 768t and 390t. In every row the card heights and the tops of the name, description and first material line are equal. The palette-block cards (Classic, Coastal, Balinese) match their neighbours' photo height (k3-style-*.png).

checks.what: The Surfaces rows' chips show a wallpaper's motif
checks.evidence: At 3× DPR, the rows show the wave, botanical leaf and herringbone motifs, the same tile as the picker swatch and the moodboard chip (j3-rows-3x.png, j3-swatch-3x.png, j4-moodboard.png).

checks.what: Deleted versions: restoring one while others remain says 'V3 is back in the strip.' in the dialog, and no snackbar lands over it
checks.evidence: Helper run, 1440: with V1 and V3 deleted, Restore V1 shows '✓ V1 is back in the strip.' (role=status) in the dialog. No snackbar at 300 ms or 1.5 s, and the dialog stays open with V3. Restoring V3, the last one, closes the dialog and snacks 'V3 restored'. I looked at vm-t82-after-restore-1.png myself.

Helper run: 'Show V3 · Relit · Golden Hour · made from V2', 'V4 · Walls · made from V3', and so on. My own read of Kevin Ng's strip: 'V3, on screen · Relit · Golden Hour · made from V2 · shared with the client'. Once a parent is deleted, the tile drops its provenance (helper's polish issue).

checks.what: Version ⋯ menu and Present by keyboard
checks.evidence: Enter on 'More options for V2' opens the menu with focus on its first row. ↓ moves (Present, Moodboard). Esc closes it and focus returns to the kebab. Present by keyboard: ← → walk the versions, and on the Original 'Before and after' is disabled and skipped. Tab cycles Close › Previous › Next › thumbnails › Done inside the dialog. Esc closes and returns focus to the kebab.

checks.what: Phone sheets (390 / 320 touch): version ⋯, Room options, Present, Deleted versions, Rename
checks.evidence: The version ⋯ is a bottom sheet titled 'V4 · Walls' with six rows. Room options is a sheet whose 'Change photo' is disabled with the meta 'Its versions were made of this photo — add a new room instead'. At 320 Present is a sheet with the arrows on the photo, an 85 px thumbs row and a footer of 'Before and after · V3' and 'Done' that fits. Page overflow is 0 everywhere.

Every control is 36 px tall with a house tooltip: Zoom out, Fit to screen, Zoom in, Hide markers, 'Before and after · V4' (Compare), 'Pin a note on the photo', Present, Download. The strip head's 'Versions' tooltip reads '← → step through the versions'.

checks.what: Reading Kevin Ng's design sends no writes
checks.evidence: Opening Kevin Ng's Living room at 1440 and 390 fired 0 POSTs. The strip shows the marks: V2 with a star, a note count and '+2' (1440) or a star and '+3' (390), and V3 with the shared mark.
